_comment: Bundled offline demo fixture for ClawBio 2.0's clinpgx port. Raw ClinPGx-API-shaped payload (same shape ClinPGxClient.search_chemical / get_clinical_annotations / get_drug_labels return) so it runs through the exact same extract_* functions a live response would. Representative structure, not a verbatim API dump. CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution applies to any values sourced from ClinPGx/PharmGKB/CPIC.
